claim.statement: SEL-LUNA-PROSPECT-03 met the issuer's declared operational predicate at the observation time: communications available, power positive, instrument controller healthy, and mission scheduler accepting work.
claim.scope: Operational-state claim for the lunar prospecting unit at the stated observation time; not a guarantee of uninterrupted future operation.

observation.method: Issuer operational-state predicate evaluated over a 60-minute signed telemetry summary and cross-checked against an unaffiliated optical observation of the expected asset location.
observation.location_context: Lunar south-polar operating region; precise security-sensitive operating coordinates withheld from the public envelope.

time_basis.notes: Onboard and ground timestamps reconciled within declared two-second uncertainty.

uncertainty.summary: Operational predicate is deterministic for the published telemetry summary, but the public summary does not expose all raw subsystem channels.

source.notes: Onboard health monitor operated under issuer-controlled flight software.

evidence_items.acquisition_method: Signed onboard health events aggregated by the issuer's public evidence pipeline.

transformations.method: Filter channels unrelated to the published operational predicate and redact security-sensitive command/position detail.

limitations: Raw command channels and precise operating coordinates are not public.

source.notes: Fictional unaffiliated public-observation provider used only for this worked example.

evidence_items.acquisition_method: Optical observation matched the expected public asset identity/location envelope.
limitations: Optical observation supports asset presence/location consistency but does not independently attest internal subsystem health.

relationship.description: Fictional unaffiliated observation provider with no issuer ownership or operating role in this worked example.

scope.summary: Attestation supports the occurrence of the cited optical observation and the observation's association with the public asset identifier; it does not attest the issuer's full operational-state predicate.

limitations: No review of onboard telemetry or internal spacecraft health was performed.

freshness_policy.rationale: Operational-state evidence becomes decision-useful only for a short period because spacecraft state can change quickly.

known_exclusions: One expected telemetry interval was unavailable during a relay handoff.
completeness.summary: The public summary covers 59 of 60 expected health intervals and discloses the single missing interval.

communications_context.notes: Evidence arrived through a delayed relay path; freshness is still based on observation time, not receipt/publication time.

redactions.reason: Raw command channels and precise operating coordinates are withheld to avoid creating operational security risk.
redactions.impact_on_claim: Redaction limits public re-performance of the full operational predicate but does not hide the declared predicate inputs in the published summary.

limitations: Public reviewers cannot reconstruct all raw onboard channels from this envelope alone.

disclaimer: Fictional worked example for the open-ipo project. Schema validity, signatures, and attestations do not establish factual truth, exchange admission, legal eligibility, or regulatory approval.
